product.title: Oregon Coast Tour from Portland

description.text: Travel from Portland to the northern Oregon Coast on a full-day tour with stops at coastal overlooks, beach towns, and scenic Highway 101 viewpoints. A local guide handles the driving while you visit Cannon Beach, Haystack Rock, and additional north-coast landmarks.

highlights: Full-day Oregon Coast tour from Portland
Visit Cannon Beach and Haystack Rock
Scenic Highway 101 driving with coastal overlooks
Mercedes-Benz Sprinter transport with hotel pickup
Small-group format with a local guide

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Travel from Portland to the northern Oregon Coast on a full-day tour with stops at coastal overlooks, beach towns, and scenic Highway 101 viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Portland departure
itineraryItems.description: Leave downtown Portland by van for the coast via Highway 26 and 101.

itineraryItems.title: Cannon Beach
itineraryItems.description: Stop in the coastal town with time near Haystack Rock when tides allow.

itineraryItems.title: Coastal overlooks
itineraryItems.description: Pause at north-coast viewpoints for photos and short walks.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Portland
itineraryItems.description: Drive back to the original Portland pickup location.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
